connector.name: Sidclaw Governance MCP
connector.registryDescription: Governance proxy for MCP servers - policy evaluation, human approval, audit trails.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package sdk. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the vladuzh account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
